title: The Blue One in the Tree
subtitle: 节日庆典 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 节日庆典（文学艺术与体育·节日与庆典）
meta: 主题语境：节日庆典（文学艺术与体育·节日与庆典）　|　核心词汇：balloon　|　正文 324 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 balloon 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1963 my mother bought ① a balloon for nine pence and held it all the way home, and my father said she had bought the string and the air was free. The ② balloon, meaning the rubber and not the party, lasted four days and was mourned for eleven; a balloon, she said, is the only present that arrives already dying.

Every ③ balloon in that hall was tied to a chair, and the ④ balloon by the door, meaning the blue one and not either of those, escaped at nine and was found in a tree in March. A balloon, my grandmother said, is nine parts air and one part somebody's wish; my father said the air is the only part you can buy.

My aunt meant the other thing entirely: she said ⑤ balloon was the whole of a birthday, meaning the thing on the string and not the rubber. The ⑥ balloon, meaning the celebration and not any of that, is the only decoration that a child is allowed to destroy; a balloon, she said, is either a toy or the only object that measures a party by how long it survives. He said the measuring is the sad half.

By 1971 the ⑦ balloon had become a photograph on a mantelpiece, and the photograph had become an argument about who let it go. The ⑧ balloon of the whole thing, my mother wrote in June, was nine years of birthdays and one tree; a balloon, she said, is either the rubber on the string or the reason you looked up. She said looking up was the part that counted.

The ⑨ balloon I remember is the blue one, which was found in March and thrown away in April. A ⑩ balloon, my mother said in 1974, is the only gift that improves by being lost; every balloon, she said, is a birthday that has agreed to look like a toy. She said the birthday is the part that lasts.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 气球（指橡胶做的那个，与聚会相对）
C. 固定搭配：buy a balloon 买一个气球
D. n. 气球（指大厅里每一个）
E. n. 气球（指门边那个蓝色的）
F. n. 气球（指生日这件事）
G. n. 气球（抽象：庆祝这件事）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: The balloon, meaning the rubber and not the party
balloon was the whole of a birthday
the balloon had become a photograph on a mantelpiece
The balloon of the whole thing
A balloon, my mother said in 1974

answers.why: buy a balloon 意为“买一个气球”，1963 年母亲花九便士买了一个气球，一路上都攥着。
balloon 意为“气球”，指橡胶做的那个而不是聚会，它撑了四天，却被哀悼了十一年。
balloon 指大厅里每一个气球，那个大厅里每一个气球都系在一把椅子上。
balloon 指门边那个蓝色的气球，它九点钟飞走了，三月在一棵树上被找到。
balloon 意为“气球”，指生日这件事，姑姑说它就是一个生日的全部，指的是线上挂着的那个东西。
balloon 为抽象用法，指庆祝这件事，是唯一允许孩子亲手毁掉的装饰。
balloon 意为“气球”，到 1971 年这个 balloon 成了壁炉台上的一张照片。
balloon 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲六月写道，整件事权衡下来是九个生日和一棵树。
balloon 意为“气球”，我记得的是那个蓝色的，它三月被找到，四月被扔掉。
balloon 为抽象总称，母亲说气球是唯一会因为丢失而变得更好的礼物。
